outlier.rule: lowest mean RMSE_log of the hybrid on the same trusted rows (no KTB_INCONSISTENT / OUTLIER_K), 3 seeds of GroupKFold(5, shuffle)

k_residual_features.rule: lowest mean RMSE_log among residual feature sets with worst K drop along O2 <= 2 % per 0.01 step

extinction_model.rule: highest mean AUC among models with no increase of P(extinction) along O2 on the 8-case grid
